metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 2010 · Alice in Wonderland
metas.description: Nineteen-year-old Alice returns to the magical world from her childhood adventure, where she reunites with her old friends and learns of her true destiny: to end the Red Queen's reign of terror.

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 2014 · Maleficent
metas.description: A vengeful fairy is driven to curse an infant princess, only to discover that the child could be the one person who can restore peace to their troubled land.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2018 · Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald
metas.description: Gellert Grindelwald plans to raise an army of wizards to rule over non-magical beings. In response, Newt Scamander's former professor, Albus Dumbledore, seeks his help to stop him.

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 2019 · Aladdin
metas.description: Aladdin, a kind thief, woos Jasmine, the princess of Agrabah, with the help of Genie. When Jafar, the grand vizier, tries to usurp the king, Jasmine, Aladdin and Genie must stop him from succeeding.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2010 · The Karate Kid
metas.description: Work causes a single mother to move to China with her young son; in his new home, the 12-year-old boy embraces Kung Fu, taught to him by a master.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2013 · Oz the Great and Powerful
metas.description: A small-time magician is swept away to an enchanted land and is forced into a power struggle among three witches.

metas.name: ★ 5.9 · 2010 · Percy Jackson & the Olympians: The Lightning Thief
metas.description: A teenager discovers he's the descendant of a Greek god and sets out on an adventure to settle an on-going battle between the gods.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2016 · Miss Peregrine's Home for Peculiar Children
metas.description: When Jacob discovers clues to a mystery that stretches across time, he finds Miss Peregrine's Home for Peculiar Children. But the danger deepens after he gets to know the residents and learns about their special powers.

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 2015 · Cinderella
metas.description: When her father unexpectedly dies, young Ella finds herself at the mercy of her cruel stepmother and her scheming stepsisters. Never one to give up hope, Ella's fortunes begin to change after meeting a dashing stranger.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 2015 · Tomorrowland
metas.description: Bound by a shared destiny, a teen bursting with scientific curiosity and a former boy-genius inventor embark on a mission to unearth the secrets of a place somewhere in time and space that exists in their collective memory.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2019 · Pokémon: Detective Pikachu
metas.description: In a world where people collect Pokémon to do battle, a boy comes across an intelligent talking Pikachu who seeks to be a detective.

metas.name: ★ 3.9 · 2010 · The Last Airbender
metas.description: Aang, a young successor to a long line of Avatars, must master all four elements and stop the Fire Nation from enslaving the Water Tribes and the Earth Kingdom.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2010 · The Chronicles of Narnia: The Voyage of the Dawn Treader
metas.description: Lucy and Edmund Pevensie return to Narnia with their cousin Eustace where they sail with King Caspian to help Narnian lords banished by an evil usurper of the throne.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 2010 · The Sorcerer's Apprentice
metas.description: A protege of the magician Merlin must train his teacher's successor - an introverted but resourceful physics prodigy - in the art of sorcery to prevent the return of Morgana le Fay.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2011 · We Bought a Zoo
metas.description: Set in Southern California, a father moves his young family to the countryside to renovate and re-open a struggling zoo.
